# AI Value Exploration Notes

> Public working notes on value uncertainty, epistemic foundations, explorability, advanced AI agency, extinction/succession, and value lock-in. Japanese is the source language; `/en/` is the English working translation. The Core is conditional and revisable rather than a settled theorem.

## Translation note
The Japanese pages are canonical source texts for conceptual changes. English pages are maintained as close working translations. Terminology is translated for argumentative function rather than word-for-word surface identity where necessary.
